about.title: About Me
paragraphs: Senior Data Center Engineer with expertise in 24/7 mission-critical operations, infrastructure monitoring, and SLA compliance. Based in Bangkok, Thailand, with proven track record in optimizing data center performance, reducing MTTR, and managing complex network/infrastructure environments.

Specialized in proactive monitoring, incident response, and operational excellence. Experience includes NOC/DCC operations, real-time monitoring systems, infrastructure management, and cross-team coordination. Committed to continuous improvement and leveraging automation to enhance operational efficiency.

achievements: Led 24/7 mission-critical data center operations, ensuring high availability and SLA compliance
Improved infrastructure stability and SLA compliance through proactive monitoring and root cause analysis
Optimized monitoring workflows, reducing MTTR by 30-40% compared to manual processes
Automated operational reporting using Excel and Power BI, improving efficiency by 50-60%
Supported 24/7 network and infrastructure monitoring, ensuring service continuity through real-time monitoring and incident triage
Improved NOC operational efficiency through proactive monitoring of network, BMS, EMS, CCTV, and access systems
Performed rapid incident triage and first-level troubleshooting, reducing MTTE and supporting escalation
Analyzed system logs to identify recurring fault patterns and support root cause analysis
